morphology.pattern_note: 日语来源的整词，按 sa.ku.ra 三个音节记忆，不拆成马来语词缀。词族所列为含此词的常用词组。

senses.zh_definition: 樱花；樱属树木所开的粉红色或白色花，尤指日本赏花文化中的樱花。
senses.en_definition: A cherry blossom, especially the pink or white blossom associated with Japan.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis bunga berwarna merah jambu atau putih yang mekar pada awal musim panas di Jepun.
senses.nuances: 马来语释义展开自输入的《Kamus Dewan》定义。实际介绍日本花季时宜说明通常在春季开花，时间随地区和品种变化，不能把“初夏”当作全国统一花期。[DBP：sakura](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sakura)；[日本国家旅游局：樱花与春季](https://www.japan.travel/en/ca/sakura-cherry-blossom/)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Musim bunga sakura menarik ramai pelancong ke Jepun setiap tahun.
dual_scenarios.zh: 樱花季每年吸引大批游客前往日本。
dual_scenarios.en: The cherry blossom season attracts many tourists to Japan every year.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论赏花照片
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Cantiknya bunga sakura ni, nak ambil gambar kat sini kejap!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Cantiknya bunga sakura ini! Saya hendak mengambil gambar di sini sebentar.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这樱花真漂亮，我想在这儿拍会儿照！
dual_scenarios.en: These cherry blossoms are gorgeous! I want to take a few photos here.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Bunga sakura kat taman tu dah mekar ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah bunga sakura di taman itu sudah mekar?
messages.zh: 那个公园里的樱花已经开了吗？
messages.en: Are the cherry blossoms in that park out yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah! Jom pergi pagi esok, ambil gambar je.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah! Mari kita pergi pagi esok untuk mengambil gambar sahaja.
messages.zh: 开啦！明早一起去，就拍拍照。
messages.en: Yes! Let's go tomorrow morning, just to take some photos.

etymology.historical_story: Sakura is the Japanese name for cherry blossoms. In Japanese culture, these flowers are closely associated with spring and hanami, the custom of gathering to admire blossoms. Malay uses the same recognizable name for the flower. Its cultural associations help explain why sakura appears naturally in descriptions of Japanese scenery and seasonal celebrations. [JNTO](https://www.japan.travel/en/ca/sakura-cherry-blossom/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sa-ku-ra 三拍配上“樱—花—开”的画面；这是画面联想，不是词源拆分。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 中性花卉名称，可用于旅游报道、课堂和日常聊天；普通名词通常写作小写 sakura。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 马来西亚有时把盛开的风铃木比作本地“樱花”。这是景观昵称，介绍植物品种时应明确区分。[马来西亚彭亨大学：本地樱花景观](https://news.ump.edu.my/general/keindahan-bunga-sakura-warnai-ump)
